title: 第7章 杜姆博士第8章 霍华德
content_zh:
第7章杜姆博士
“堕落，实在太堕落了。”
赌城某个酒店的总统套房，安德鲁站在阳台上望着下方的灯红酒绿，一脸悲伤。
明明定好三天前去纽約办正事的，结果，玩了一天一天又一天。
这也不怪他，周围美女如云，还有一群人千方百计的让讨他开心，他又孤独了一年，实在很难不堕落。
什么，为什么美女围着他转？当然是因为他……有钱，没办法，逢赌必赢，想没钱都难。
因为赢得太多，那些赌场老板甚至开支票请求他不要再来，当然，也有想来硬的，甚至还有人想打劫安德鲁。
这些人，全部神秘消失——连人带灵魂一起被收入重生地狱，为重生地狱的现代化努力奋斗，呃，没工资，二十四小时上班的那种。
“正事还是要做的，我现在是众矢之的，没有实力，迟早被那些魔王吞掉。”
安德鲁遥遥望着纽約的方向，喃喃自语道：“杜姆博士，还有托尼·斯塔克，我们很快就会见面。”
……
杜姆集团是曼哈顿这几年颇为有名的新兴科技集团，其董事长维克多·冯·杜姆是一个科技和经商的超级天才，他只了几年时间，就将杜姆集团发展成上市公司，甚至在太空拥有一个小型空间站。
问题是，杜姆博士并不开心，他来美利坚开公司，不是为了赚钱，而是为了借助高科技复活他的母亲。
杜姆博士的母亲辛西娅是一位吉普赛女巫，她为了保护自己的国家，与墨菲斯托做交易，结果，国家没救到，反而自己的灵魂落入墨菲斯托手中。
“难道我的路选错了，我应该去学习魔法？”
样貌冷酷的杜姆博士坐在办公室里，眉头紧锁，以现在的科技，根本不可能打穿地狱去救辛西娅。
就在这时，一个声音突然响起：“以你的天赋，学习魔法前途不可限量。”
“谁？”
杜姆博士一惊，猛的抬头，见到一个穿风衣，气质神秘的东方男子坐在他对面。
安德鲁笑道：“不要紧张，虽然我是魔王，但我不吃人，即使要吃，也不会生吃，我会多加点辣椒。”

“魔王？你的话成功让我更加紧张了。”
杜姆博士毕竟不是一般人，他深吸一口气，问道：“请问这位魔王先生，降临我的办公室有何贵干？”
安德鲁赞赏的看了杜姆博士一眼，说道：“为了和你做一个交易。”
“我不和魔鬼做交易。”
杜姆博士冷声说道：“和魔鬼做交易的人，从来不会有好下场，比如我的母亲。”
“名声臭了，生意不好做啊。”
安德鲁叹了一口气，张开右手，一个女巫的灵魂在他掌心沉睡：“真不做？”
“辛西娅！”
杜姆博士面色一变，他猛的站起来，问道：“你是墨菲斯托？”

Chapter 7 Dr. Doom
"Degenerate, really depraved."
In the presidential suite of a hotel in the casino, Andrew stood on the balcony and looked at the feasting and feasting below, with a sad look on his face.
We had obviously planned to go to New York for business three days ago, but in the end, we spent day after day having fun.
It's not his fault. There are so many beauties around him, and there are a group of people who are doing everything possible to make him happy. He has been alone for another year, and it is really difficult not to fall.
What, why are beauties surrounding him? Of course it's because he... has money, but he has no choice but to win every bet, even if he doesn't have money, it's hard.
Because he won too much, the casino owners even wrote checks to beg him not to come again. Of course, there were also those who wanted to do it hard, and some even wanted to rob Andrew.
These people all disappeared mysteriously - they were sent to the Rebirth Hell together with their souls, and they worked hard for the modernization of the Rebirth Hell. Well, they were not paid and worked 24 hours a day.
"Business still needs to be done. I am the target of public criticism now. I have no strength and will be swallowed up by those demon kings sooner or later."
Andrew looked far away in the direction of New York and murmured to himself: "Dr. Doom, and Tony Stark, we will meet soon."
…
The Doom Group is a well-known emerging technology group in Manhattan in recent years. Its chairman, Victor von Doom, is a super genius in technology and business. In just a few years, he developed the Doom Group into a listed company and even owned a small space station in space.
The problem is, Dr. Doom is not happy. He came to the United States to open a company, not to make money, but to resurrect his mother with the help of high technology.
Dr. Doom's mother Cynthia is a gypsy witch. In order to protect her country, she made a deal with Mephisto. As a result, the country was not saved, but her soul fell into the hands of Mephisto.
"Did I choose the wrong path? I should study magic?"
The cold-looking Dr. Doom sat in the office, frowning. With current technology, it is simply impossible to break through hell to save Cynthia.
At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded: "With your talent, your future in learning magic is limitless."
"Who?"
Dr. Doom was startled. He looked up suddenly and saw an oriental man wearing a trench coat and a mysterious temperament sitting opposite him.
Andrew smiled and said: "Don't be nervous. Although I am the devil, I don't eat people. Even if I want to eat them, I won't eat them raw. I will add more chili peppers."
"Demon King? Your words succeeded in making me even more nervous."
After all, Dr. Doom is not an ordinary person. He took a deep breath and asked: "Excuse me, what is the purpose of Mr. Demon King coming to my office?"
Andrew glanced at Dr. Doom appreciatively and said, "To make a deal with you."
"I don't make deals with the devil."
Dr. Doom said coldly: "People who make deals with the devil never end well, such as my mother."
"It has a bad reputation and it's hard to do business."
Andrew sighed and opened his right hand. The soul of a witch fell asleep in his palm: "You really don't want to do it?"
"Cynthia!"
Dr. Doom's expression changed. He stood up suddenly and asked, "Are you Mephisto?"
